class.name: DisFirePdu
class.brief_description: Fire PDU (type 2): a weapon was fired or an expendable was launched.
class.description: A Fire PDU announces that [member DisWarfarePdu.firing_entity_id] fired a munition at [member DisWarfarePdu.location_ecef]. It is 96 bytes long and has protocol family 2 (Warfare); most fields are inherited from [DisWarfarePdu]. A later [DisDetonationPdu] with the same [member DisWarfarePdu.event_id] reports what happened to the munition. [member DisWarfarePdu.munition_id] is the munition or expendable ID in a Fire PDU, and [member DisWarfarePdu.velocity] is the munition's velocity right after firing (ECEF, m/s).

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Fire PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Fire PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], or fewer than 96 bytes). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last known field, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].

members.member: Index of the fire mission this shot belongs to (unsigned 32-bit).
Range to the target in metres (32-bit float on the wire). 0 means unknown.
